findings.section: Why this shape (vloop's own sessions are unaffected) / Acceptance step 3
findings.summary: The brief says vloop's Claude sessions are unaffected by the declaration, but nothing has measured it. Those sessions do read .claude/settings.json, and the acceptance checks only Copilot.
findings.evidence: internal/driver/session.go:109-111 starts every Claude session with --setting-sources project --settings <fence> --plugin-dir, so the project's .claude/settings.json is loaded. The measurement the brief cites (B13 brief, lines 87-93, 2026-10-11) covered user-scope plugins only. It predates enabledPlugins in this repository (added by B14, commit b2d2c654, 2026-10-14) and never covered extraKnownMarketplaces, which this brief adds. Doctor's trust row makes vloop run require a trusted folder, which is the condition under which Claude acts on a declaration. The possible effects: a run or brief-review session loads the marketplace's vloop next to the --plugin-dir one (two plugins with the same name, maybe at different versions), or it fetches and installs the marketplace (network access and a write under ~/.claude). Acceptance step 3 checks this for Copilot sessions only.
findings.fix: Before marking the brief ready, the operator measures it. In a trusted clone that has the declaration and an older vloop@vloop installed, run claude -p with vloop run's flags and --output-format stream-json, then read the plugins and skills listed in the init event, and check that ~/.claude/plugins is unchanged. Record the result in the design note's new section and add a Claude step to the acceptance. If the declared plugin does load, the operator must decide what to do, for example have the session's --settings set enabledPlugins["vloop@vloop"] to false. That changes how vloop run loads the plugin, which this brief puts out of scope.

findings.section: P3 / P4 (the plugin list --json shapes) / Binding references
findings.summary: Unsure. Doctor will parse the output of claude and copilot `plugin list --json`. The brief says it observed that output on this machine on 2026-11-03, but no document in the repository records it. The added design-note section covers only the declaration.
findings.evidence: The brief relies on these unrecorded claims: Claude's entries carry scope and projectPath; Copilot's entries are {name, marketplace, version, enabled, source}; Copilot's enabled flag depends on the working directory; claude plugin update vloop@vloop updates a project-scope install. The diff of docs/design-notes/copilot-cli-experiments.md adds only 'A repository's plugin declaration'. The repository's guideline says an external tool's format comes from the tool or its docs. I could not settle this: running claude/copilot plugin list --json was denied in this session.
findings.fix: Add the two observed outputs, trimmed and with paths masked, to the design note's new section. Cite them from P3 and P4 so the stubs' JSON has a recorded source.

findings.summary: The remedy '(vloop upgrade writes it)' is wrong in two cases the brief itself defines.
findings.evidence: Under P1's merge rules, an existing enabledPlugins["vloop@vloop"]: false is kept, so upgrade does not write true. When the stamp equals the binary, upgrade returns 'already at <v>' before any step (internal/cli/upgrade.go:49-51; P1 keeps that unchanged).
findings.fix: Drop the parenthetical, or say it as 'vloop init and the next vloop upgrade write it unless the file already sets it'.

findings.summary: Two small gaps. 'A stub copilot … that answers … the login check' is wrong, because doctor's login check does not call copilot. And P4 does not say what happens to the row when the config cannot be read.
findings.evidence: copilotLoggedIn (internal/cli/doctor.go:217-227) checks the token variables and then runs gh auth token. The agent.* keys are read only when the config loads (doctor.go:116-121, inside the cerr == nil branch).
findings.fix: Write 'a stub copilot that answers --version, and GH_TOKEN set'. Add 'no copilot plugin row when the config check is a problem'.

decisions: Existing values win, including vloop@vloop: false: agree.
No version pin in the declaration; doctor's version row names the update command as an option: agree.
vloop's own sessions are unaffected by the declaration: not established for Claude sessions (finding 1); the operator must measure it.
The Claude row keeps the name 'plugin' and the new row is 'copilot plugin': agree, because --json consumers read the name.
The copilot plugin row appears only when an agent.* key is copilot, agent.review-brief included: agree.
No remedy requires a global change, and claude plugin enable is no longer suggested: agree.
The P1 step comes after CLAUDE.md in init and after .gitignore in upgrade; upgrade prints no line when the file is kept: agree.
Doctor's plugin rows run `plugin list --json` with the repository root as the working directory: agree.
